title: Kerja Mental vs Kerja Fizikal (gaya PS2 story)
voiceStyle: Cakap dalam BM Malaysia santai, nada relatable dan mesra macam kawan bercerita. Sedikit dramatik di babak 1, 4, 5 dan 6 (perlahan sikit, tekan "lori langgar" dan "mata segar"), kemudian naik hangat dan ceria di babak 7. Sebut nombor dengan jelas.

scenes.say: Ali duduk je sepanjang hari. Tak angkat apa-apa pun. Tapi kenapa balik rumah rasa macam lori langgar?

shots.imagePrompt: Ali sitting at office desk staring at computer monitor, fluorescent office, tired eyes, medium shot
close-up of Ali face exhausted, dark circles under eyes, monitor glow on face
Ali walking home at night on city street, slouched, dragging his bag, wide shot

scenes.say: Abu pula angkat simen dari pagi sampai petang. Badan penat, memang. Tapi cerita dia lain.

shots.imagePrompt: Abu carrying a heavy cement bag on his shoulder at a construction site, bright sun, low angle
Abu wiping sweat from forehead at construction site, close-up
Abu sitting on bricks drinking water, smiling, sunset construction site

scenes.say: Otak kau cuma dua peratus berat badan, tapi guna lebih kurang dua puluh peratus tenaga badan masa rehat. Otak memang kuat makan.

shots.imagePrompt: glowing human brain floating in dark room with blue energy, 3D game render
Ali at desk with glowing brain visible through his head, energy draining
close-up of Ali holding his head with both hands at desk, stressed

scenes.say: Satu kajian cadangkan, fikir berat enam jam buat glutamate bertimbun dalam bahagian otak untuk buat keputusan. Tanda otak letih.

shots.imagePrompt: Ali at desk late at night surrounded by stacks of documents, clock showing 11pm
extreme close-up of Ali eyes, bloodshot, reflection of spreadsheet
Ali forehead on keyboard, office empty and dark

scenes.say: Kajian lain, lepas sembilan puluh minit kerja otak berat, orang cepat give up berbasikal. Enam ratus empat puluh saat, berbanding tujuh ratus lima puluh empat.

shots.imagePrompt: Ali on an exercise bike in a gym looking exhausted and giving up
Ali sweating on exercise bike, slumping forward over handlebars
digital stopwatch on gym screen, dark room

scenes.say: Malam, Ali baring tapi mata segar. Stres memang dikaitkan dengan tidur terganggu. Kajian juga nampak senaman biasa bantu kualiti tidur.

shots.imagePrompt: Ali lying in bed at night eyes wide open, dark bedroom, phone glow
top-down view of Ali awake in bed staring at ceiling, blue moonlight
Abu sleeping peacefully in bed, snoring, warm lamp light

scenes.say: Penat otak tu betul. Kau tak lemah. Follow untuk fakta kerja & otak yang korang tak tahu.

shots.imagePrompt: Ali and Abu standing side by side smiling at sunrise on a rooftop
Ali stretching arms happily by a window, morning light

characters.Ali: Malaysian Malay man around 28, short black hair, light brown skin, white long-sleeve office shirt, dark blue tie
characters.Abu: Malaysian Malay construction worker around 35, tan skin, short beard, yellow hard hat, orange hi-vis safety vest, dusty work clothes
